lines.speaker: Villager
lines.text: Hello, traveler! Welcome to this humble test map.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.text: Have you seen the old lighthouse to the north?

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.text: They say its light has not shone in many years... not since the cartridge was lost.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.text: Some folk still believe it will shine again one day.

lines.speaker: Elder
lines.text: But that is just an old man's hope. Safe travels to you.

lines.speaker: Wanderer
lines.text: Funny thing about this town — the roads all seem to lead back to the same square no matter which direction you walk. I have been circling for three days now and the fountain never moves. Perhaps the map itself is haunted. Or perhaps I am simply very bad at navigating. Either way, I hope your journey goes better than mine has.
